> [!WARNING]
> **Safety & Privacy Reminder**:
> Do **NOT** attach or paste:
> - SQLite database files (`*.sqlite`, `*.db`);
> - Torrent files (`.torrent`) or magnet link catalogs;
> - Scraped HTML dumps or full forum page exports;
> - Copyrighted screenshots, game covers, or game media;
> - Browser profiles (`scraper-profile/`, `userData/`);
> - Session cookies (`cookies.json`, `storageState.json`);
> - Passwords, private tokens, or credentials.
